summary: Frontend-only code review + smoke-load test of the three converted list screens (Dealers single-column, Claims Dealers-mode, Bundles list). Verified all three now use TbvListPanel with the `skinListPanel: { flex:1, marginHorizontal:16, ... }` style (matching the Inventory reference), and that TbvListPanel.tsx is correctly written as a FILL-PARENT industrial container that measures its own laid-out box (flex-driven) and paints a 9-slice metal frame behind a padded scrolling child. Empty states correctly fall back to the page-level ScrollView, and plain themes correctly bypass TbvListPanel and render via ShadowBox. Smoke-navigated to /dealers, /claims, /bundle in mobile viewport (390x844) — all three screens mount without React render errors (the only red overlay seen was a dev LogBox 'Not authenticated' from API 401s because the test session was logged out; that is NOT a render bug). Unable to exercise the actual 'panel stays within screen + rows scroll inside it' visual behavior under a populated Steel/Iron Forge theme because (a) the AuthContext does not read localStorage, so a programmatic token injection did not authenticate, and (b) walking the full login -> theme switch -> add dealers/bundles flow exceeds the testing-agent token budget. Code review supports correctness with high confidence; main agent should self-verify on the iOS/Android preview build.
action_items: Main agent: visually self-verify in Steel and Iron Forge themes that on /dealers, /claims (DEALERS chip), and /bundle the metal panel's bottom edge sits ABOVE the bottom safe-area / FAB and that rows scroll inside the panel (look for the same behavior as /inventory). The code path is correct, but actual layout sizing depends on Expo web vs native — confirm on iOS simulator or Expo Go.

Dead-code cleanup (low priority, no functional impact): in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/claims.tsx the inner `isIndustrial` branch inside the page ScrollView (lines ~554-589, the old skinned dealers list inside ScrollView) is now unreachable because the new TbvListPanel branch at lines 399-449 catches `isIndustrial && !searchActive && mode==='dealers'` first. Safe to delete in a follow-up.

Note: the public web preview currently shows my test session as unauthenticated (LogBox 'Not authenticated' on /dealers). That is just because localStorage-injected tokens are not read by the native AuthContext on web — it is not a regression from this change.
critical_code_review_comments: TbvListPanel.tsx correctly uses `flex: 1` on its inner padded content View and accepts `style` so callers pass `{ flex:1, marginHorizontal:16, ... }` — this is the proper bounded-parent pattern needed for an internal ScrollView/FlatList to scroll without stretching the parent. Matches the proven Inventory implementation.

dealers.tsx (lines 220-263): when isIndustrial && gridCols===1 && dealers.length>0, ALL dealers render inside ONE TbvListPanel with a flex:1 ScrollView child. Correct pattern. Empty path uses a separate page ScrollView. Grid view (gridCols>1) keeps the existing FlatList. Good.

claims.tsx (lines 399-449): when isIndustrial && !searchActive && mode==='dealers' && (filteredDealers.length>0 || unassigned>0), the dealer rows render inside ONE TbvListPanel + internal ScrollView with RefreshControl. Correct.
bundle/index.tsx (lines 111-125): when isIndustrial && bundles.length>0, all bundle rows render inside ONE TbvListPanel + internal ScrollView with RefreshControl. Correct.
All three screens declare `skinListPanel: { flex: 1, marginHorizontal: 16, ... }` in their StyleSheet — consistent with the Inventory reference.
Plain themes (Plain Light/Dark) correctly bypass TbvListPanel and render via ShadowBox / ScrollView — no regression risk.

success_rate.frontend: code-review pass; visual scroll behavior NOT exercised under authenticated skinned theme due to token budget

context_for_next_testing_agent: If a follow-up agent has more token budget: (1) sign in via the UI as ryan@ryan.com / ryan1234 (token injection into localStorage does NOT work — the AuthContext does not read it on web), (2) go to More -> Appearance and switch to Steel theme, (3) on /dealers verify with `document.body.getBoundingClientRect()` and a JS measurement of the TbvListPanel element that its bottom is <= window.innerHeight - safeAreaBottom, (4) scroll inside the panel and confirm rows move while the panel border stays put. Repeat for /claims (tap DEALERS chip) and /bundle. Also confirm Iron Forge theme. The auth screens regression (Steel SIGN IN / CREATE ACCOUNT tabs uniform brushed-steel, Forgot Password follows theme) was NOT visually tested in this iteration.
rca_of_issue: n/a — this iteration is a structural verification of a list-panel refactor, not a bug fix. The refactor correctly applies the proven Inventory pattern (TbvListPanel with flex:1 + internal ScrollView) to the three previously-stretching screens. Behavior risk: low; reusable component is unchanged and the per-screen edits are minimal and symmetric.
